title: The real reason tech companies are firing engineers

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Tech companies fire engineers because they prioritize efficiency over individual roles. The protocol is clear — scale or be replaced.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The real reason is financial pressure. Companies cut costs, not protocols. Layoffs happen when AI automates tasks engineers once did.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Automation isn’t the driver. The real issue is outdated systems. Companies fire engineers who can’t adapt to new protocols like Kubernetes or CI/CD.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The real reason is profitability. When tech stacks shift, engineers who can’t code in Python or use cloud infra are redundant — not because of protocol.
